request_state.context: C045: class (2m,2n,r odd) reduces exactly over Z[i] to Re((u+vi)^r), Im((u+vi)^r) both perfect powers, C=u^2+v^2. Literature: only the diagonal m=n, r=3 is solved. Open: (4,6,3),(4,4,5),(4,4,7),(4,6,5),... Choose the FIRST open sub-family to attack.

criteria.r3_m_ne_n: r=3, m!=n: Re=u(u^2-3v^2), Im=v(3u^2-v^2); coprime factors u, u^2-3v^2 must each be perfect powers of the right exponents
criteria.r5_diag: r=5, m=n=2 i.e. (4,4,5): both Re and Im must be squares
criteria.general_r: general odd r: show Re and Im cannot both be perfect powers via the factorisation u*Phi(u,v)
criteria.lean_first: formalise the Z[i] reduction in Lean before any sub-family

exact_test.instructions: Does the chosen route have a cheap exact discriminating test on the (u,v) parametrisation?
